name: GUERRILLA WARFARE
text: This turning point every friendly Phobos operative gains the unique action GUERRILLA WARFARE (1 AP): change this operative's order. Not in an enemy control range.

name: AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
text: This turning point friendly Phobos operatives ignore every injured stat change (Move and weapon Hit).

name: DEADLY SHOTS
text: This turning point a friendly Phobos operative's ranged weapons have Balanced while it shoots, either in an activation where it has not yet charged, fallen back or repositioned, or at a target that is not in cover and is more than 6 inches away. Checked per target.

name: LETHAL ASSAULTS
text: This turning point, whenever a friendly Phobos operative fights (not retaliates), its melee weapons have Balanced, and Lethal 5+ as well if it charged earlier in the same activation.

name: PATIENT AMBUSH
text: When it is your turn to activate a friendly operative, skip that activation: play passes to your opponent.

name: CRITICAL SHOT
text: When a friendly Phobos operative shoots with a bolt weapon and keeps a critical hit, the first critical hit that deals damage deals D3 extra damage.

name: TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
text: When any operative shoots a friendly Phobos operative, after the defence roll, keep one of your normal defence successes as a critical success instead.

name: STEALTH ASSAULT
text: A friendly Phobos operative that had a Conceal order when activated was given Engage, then charged and fought as its first two actions: after it resolves its first attack die you immediately resolve one more of your dice before the opponent resolves.

name: OMNI-SCRAMBLER
text: A strategic gambit (free of CP) while a friendly Infiltrator is in the killzone: pick an enemy a friendly Infiltrator can see, or that is within 6 inches of a friendly Voxbreaker. For the rest of this turning point's Firefight phase that enemy cannot be activated or take any action until your opponent has activated as many operatives as you had Infiltrators in the killzone, or it is their last operative left to activate.
